script_text: Taurus, Saturn completes a rare precision aspect this week and everything shifts for you. Early this week Mercury stations direct in Leo squaring Venus in your 2nd House of possessions bringing scattered money energy. The Moon in Capricorn intensifies financial stress through Wednesday. Thursday Venus enters your 5th House trining Neptune in Pisces to reveal a powerful love opportunity that catches you off guard. Mars opposes Uranus in Taurus on Friday sparking sudden career jolts. By Sunday the Moon flows home restoring grounded earth energy and calm. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury's direct station aligns with Jupiter in Cancer flooding your 11th House career networks with breakthrough opportunities. Tuesday is your hardest day as the Moon in Capricorn clashes with Saturn dumping worry into your 2nd House. Hold firm on any investment until Thursday; act only with patience. Follow us for daily updates.
